leadStory: The cloud that hung over the summer has finally taken a signature: Fenway Sports Group confirmed the sale of a strategic minority stake, reported at around a third of the club, to a consortium led by Amit Bhatia and backed by Jeff Bezos and Eduardo Saverin, a deal valuing Liverpool near $7bn. Bhatia becomes vice-chairman and joins an expanded board; Bezos takes no board seat, and FSG keep control with the group holding an option on more later. The club insists player budgets stay with the sporting operation. On the grass, Barcola talks have gone club-to-club with Liverpool 'confident', and Tottenham have stepped up for Cody Gakpo. Como close the pre-season at Anfield on Sunday before Newcastle away opens the league on August 23.
subject: A confirmed boardroom deal and a valuation near $7bn, an institutional story rather than a single photographable hero moment
